<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Moray Ambush](/Feats.aspx?ID=5295) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 21

**Trigger**
You are [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) and a creature who hasn’t detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

</column>

---

Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding. Stride or [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) directly toward the triggering creature and make a melee Strike against it. The target creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to this attack.

**Special** If you’re mounted on an eel, you can have the eel move instead of yourself.
name: Moray Ambush
